svg.title: TYPE_MOVE_AGV -> PlanAgvMoveJob()
svg.desc: Two MOVE_AGV jobs in one request. An empty AGV produces an AgvMove; an AGV that is carrying a tray produces a TrayMove whose AGV is already fixed.
